baseline_reproducer: Before the fix, replacing_executor_waker_runs_destructor_without_completion_lock fails because the old registration destructor observes the completion mutex locked.
benchmark_scope: Pending polls of public OutboxStore::claim while its trusted clock blocks the worker. Two profiles: same waker, or switch between two distinct wakers every poll. Storage setup/work, release, and final response collection are untimed.
benchmark_method: Each round: 20 alternating baseline/candidate process pairs, one process warmup per binary, CPU 0, 3000000 polls per profile. No agent compilation/tests during timed comparisons. No host-wide workload/frequency/cache control.
pilot_scope: Same production poll code, before the final test-only additions. Rebuilding after adding tests changed executable hash, so final timing was rerun. Both complete rounds retained.
baseline_fixture_scope: The candidate benchmark differs from the baseline fixture only in a comment and scoped manual_noop_waker lint allowance. Distinct Arc-backed wakers are required for the changing-registration profile. Regression tests were present in the working tree during the baseline build, and are excluded from the benchmark library by cfg(test).
